headline: Trevecca take their winning run to Lee
dek: Trevecca have not lost since Lee beat them at Trevecca in September, the only defeat in their sixteen matches this season. They go to Lee level on points with AUM at the head of the table, in the only match left on the schedule.
displaced_by: The standing dek's 'fifteen' no longer holds at sixteen matches, and Trevecca's next match is at Lee, the only side to beat them, with AUM level on points.
